title: Mud Carey and the Jack Carey band personnel
summary: Allen and Vincent sort Mud Carey from Mud Carter and list the men in Jack Carey's band, including Chester and Charlie.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Not Mud Carey. Yeah, Mud Carey, not Mud Carter, Mud Carey. Do you remember Jack Terry, Bjornie? I know him, yeah. Yeah, that's what I said. He was playing with him, Bjornie then.
Well, Mud Carter and Mud Carey are two different guys. Yeah, I know both of them.

Mud Carter's a slender, tall guy. He's a bull guy. He's a jack cattle hood, bunch of youngster then. He picked up me, Chester, Charlie, and let me see who else he had. Chester, Charlie, and myself, and him. Who are we at on clarinet? We're at the rubber show bar. Yeah. Usually, when the rubber show comes through. Yeah, yeah. What's Chester's play? It was Chester and Charlie, what is when you first come in the band? Chester's. It was Chester and Charlie and me when you first come in the band. We used to pick you up sometime in racing, remember? And we'd go in the country.
Yeah, Chester's art. You know, Marge Penkin, and he's better than him. Yeah.
